title: [Bug] Anthropic API Error: Rate limit reached without reaching actual limits
body:
**Bug Description**
"  ⎿  API Error: Rate limit reached" but I'm no where near limits.  How do I use Claude?  What a shitty error message

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: iTerm.app
- Version: 2.1.81
- Feedback ID: 6cb0927c-146f-443a-a120-c13efebed3e6

**Errors**

[{"error":"Error: NON-FATAL: Lock acquisition failed for /Users/jasonewillis/.local/share/claude/versions/2.1.81 (expected in multi-process scenarios)\n    at TET (/$bunfs/root/src/entrypoints/cli.js:2724:2174)\n    at fgq (/$bunfs/root/src/entrypoints/cli.js:2724:1318)\n    at processTicksAndRejections (native:7:39)","timestamp":"2026-03-22T23:19:48.928Z"},{"error":"Error: 429 {\"type\":\"error\",\"error\":{\"type\":\"rate_limit_error\",\"message\":\"Extra usage is required for long context requests.\"},\"request_id\":\"req_011CZJyfm1MFr8G45DhKrGmX\"}\n    at generate (/$bunfs/root/src/entrypoints/cli.js:205:286312)\n    at makeRequest (/$bunfs/root/src/entrypoints/cli.js:244:5435)\n    at processTicksAndRejections (native:7:39)","timestamp":"2026-03-22T23:21:53.490Z"}]
